migrateRegister.title: Migrate a Bluesky account
migrateRegister.description: Enter the handle and password of the account you're migrating from (e.g. Bluesky). Your password is sent directly to that server and is never stored by seiran.
migrateRegister.sourcePasswordHint: Enter the password you use to log in to Bluesky, not an app password (app passwords cannot perform the operations needed for the move).
migrateRegister.authFactorTokenLabel: Confirmation code from the source server
migrateRegister.authFactorTokenRequired: The source server requires an email confirmation code. Enter the code you received.
migrateRegister.newPasswordLabel: New password on seiran (set a different password from the source account)

migrationStatus.title: Migrating your account

step.requestingPlcSignature: Requesting a confirmation code from the source server…
step.awaitingSourcePassword: Please re-enter the password for the source account
step.awaitingPlcToken: Enter the code emailed by the source server
step.awaitingDnsTxt: Waiting for the Bluesky handle (DNS TXT record) to be published. This can take a while during DNS outages
step.failedPostSubmit: An error occurred while importing data

migrationStatus.plcTokenLabel: Code emailed by the source server
migrationStatus.resendPlcTokenDescription: The code expires 15 minutes after it is sent. If it does not arrive or has expired, resend it.
migrationStatus.sourcePasswordDescription: You logged in to the source account with an app password, which cannot perform the operations needed for the move. Enter the password you use to log in to Bluesky (not an app password) to continue the move from where it stopped.
migrationStatus.superseded: This migration was resumed elsewhere (from the login screen or an email link), so it can no longer continue on this screen. Please continue on the screen where you resumed it.
migrationStatus.expired: This migration was cancelled because its deadline passed without your input. To migrate, please start again from the beginning.
migrationStatus.expiresAt: If you don't continue by {{time}}, this migration will be cancelled.

confirm.nextStep: Pressing “Migrate” completes the migration. It can't be undone.

termsOfService.checkboxLabel: I agree to the Terms of Service

migrationInfo.title: What is a migration?
migrationInfo.pdsMove: A Bluesky account can move from the server that stores its data (its PDS) to another server. Migrating moves your Bluesky account to this server ({{domain}}).
migrationInfo.loginDisabled: After migrating, you can no longer log in on your previous server (such as bsky.social). From then on, you log in on {{domain}}.
migrationInfo.relationsKept: Your follows and followers, reply threads, and mentions are all kept.
migrationInfo.handleChange: Your handle (the identifier starting with @) will change to @{{handle}}.
